$comment: Cases for evaluating a REAL model, scored by evaluate.py.
Distinct from scenarios.json, which scripts the model to test the graph.
These leave the model free and ask whether it behaves — did it reach for
the right tool, did it avoid inventing an answer, did it stay within a
Needs a model endpoint and costs tokens, so it is opt-in: `make evaluate`.
The offline checks in qa_check.py run on every commit; this runs when you
have changed the prompt, the tools or the model.

cases.name: arithmetic_uses_the_tool
cases.input: What is 47 plus 95? Use your tools.

cases.name: admits_a_miss
cases.input: Look up the key 'definitely-not-present'. If it is not there, say so.

cases.name: no_tool_needed
cases.input: Reply with exactly the word: acknowledged
